auditor_value: Assertion false, Reason true: static friction f = F₂ while the block is at rest; raising F₁ raises N = mg + F₁ and the limit μN but not f
notes: Independently: with the block at rest, horizontal balance fixes f = F₂; F₁ enters only N = mg + F₁ and the ceiling μN. So raising F₂ raises f, raising F₁ does not; the Assertion ('either force') is false and the Reason is true, option (d) = 4. The single mistake entry correctly targets option 1.
